components.name: NotificationStack
components.doc: A pile of notifications that fans out into a list on hover or focus; cards leave by swipe, button, or Delete, and the rest close ranks on a spring.

components.name: NotificationStackPreview
components.doc: Ready preview: the stack on a quiet stage, with room underneath to fan out.

members.name: title
members.doc: First line: who or what the notification is about.

members.name: kind
members.doc: Picks the icon and its tone. Defaults to `message`.

members.name: unread
members.doc: Shows the unread dot next to the title.

members.name: notifications
members.doc: Notifications, newest first. Pass it with `onNotificationsChange` to control the list.

members.name: defaultNotifications
members.doc: Starting list when uncontrolled. Defaults to sample notifications.

members.name: onNotificationsChange
members.doc: Called with the remaining list after a dismissal, a clear, or a restore.

members.name: onDismiss
members.doc: Called with the id of each dismissed notification.

members.name: expanded
members.doc: Keeps the stack fanned out. Hover and keyboard focus fan it out on their own.

members.name: defaultExpanded
members.doc: Whether the stack starts fanned out when uncontrolled.

members.name: onExpandedChange
members.doc: Called when the person pins or unpins the fanned out state.

members.name: visible
members.doc: How many cards show in the collapsed pile.
